## Important security notes for banking apps
A real banking app must include:
- TLS certificate pinning
- Secure token storage using EncryptedSharedPreferences or Keystore
- Biometric authentication
- Root/jailbreak detection
- Anti-tampering / anti-debugging
- Server-side authorization checks
- PCI DSS / financial compliance
- Audit logging
- Session timeout and re-authentication
- No sensitive data in logs

## 6) Repository

### `BankRepository.kt`
```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.TransactionEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.model.LoginRequest
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.BankApi
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map

class BankRepository(
    private val api: BankApi,
    private val dao: TransactionDao
) {
    suspend fun login(username: String, password: String) =
        api.login(LoginRequest(username, password))

    suspend fun refreshTransactions() {
        val remote = api.getTransactions()
        dao.clearAll()
        dao.insertAll(
            remote.map {
                TransactionEntity(
                    id = it.id,
                    title = it.title,
                    amount = it.amount,
                    date = it.date,
                    type = it.type
                )
            }
        )
    }

    fun observeTransactions() = dao.observeTransactions().map { list ->
        list.map {
            com.example.bankapp.data.model.Transaction(
                id = it.id,
                title = it.title,
                amount = it.amount,
                date = it.date,
                type = it.type
            )
        }
    }
}
```

## 7) Hilt module

### `AppModule.kt`
```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.di

import android.content.Context
import androidx.room.Room
import com.example.bankapp.data.BankRepository
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.BankDatabase
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.BankApi
import dagger.Module
import dagger.Provides
import dagger.hilt.InstallIn
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.logging.HttpLoggingInterceptor
import retrofit2.Retrofit
import retrofit2.converter.moshi.MoshiConverterFactory
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
object AppModule {

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideOkHttpClient(): OkHttpClient {
        val logging = HttpLoggingInterceptor().apply {
            level = HttpLoggingInterceptor.Level.BODY
        }
        return OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .addInterceptor(logging)
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideRetrofit(client: OkHttpClient): Retrofit {
        return Retrofit.Builder()
            .baseUrl("https://api.example.com/")
            .client(client)
            .addConverterFactory(MoshiConverterFactory.create())
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideBankApi(retrofit: Retrofit): BankApi =
        retrofit.create(BankApi::class.java)

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideDatabase(@ApplicationContext context: Context): BankDatabase =
        Room.databaseBuilder(context, BankDatabase::class.java, "bank.db").build()

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideRepository(api: BankApi, db: BankDatabase): BankRepository =
        BankRepository(api, db.transactionDao())
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.dashboard

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.data.BankRepository

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

@HiltViewModel
class DashboardViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val repository: BankRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    val transactions: StateFlow<List<Transaction>> =
        repository.observeTransactions().stateIn(
            viewModelScope,
            SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5000),
            emptyList()
        )

    fun refresh() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            repository.refreshTransactions()
        }
    }
}
```

## 6) Secure token storage

### `TokenManager.kt`
```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import android.content.Context
import androidx.security.crypto.EncryptedSharedPreferences
import androidx.security.crypto.MasterKey

class TokenManager(context: Context) {
    private val masterKey = MasterKey.Builder(context)
        .setKeyScheme(MasterKey.KeyScheme.AES256_GCM)
        .build()

    private val prefs = EncryptedSharedPreferences.create(
        context,
        "secure_prefs",
        masterKey,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefKeyEncryptionScheme.AES256_SIV,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefValueEncryptionScheme.AES256_GCM
    )

    fun saveToken(token: String) {
        prefs.edit().putString("auth_token", token).apply()
    }

    fun getToken(): String? = prefs.getString("auth_token", null)

    fun clearToken() {
        prefs.edit().remove("auth_token").apply()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.di

import android.content.Context
import com.example.bankapp.data.api.BankApi
import com.example.bankapp.data.repository.TokenManager
import dagger.Module
import dagger.Provides
import dagger.hilt.InstallIn
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.logging.HttpLoggingInterceptor
import retrofit2.Retrofit
import retrofit2.converter.moshi.MoshiConverterFactory
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
object NetworkModule {

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideTokenManager(@ApplicationContext context: Context): TokenManager =
        TokenManager(context)

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideOkHttpClient(tokenManager: TokenManager): OkHttpClient {
        val logging = HttpLoggingInterceptor().apply {
            level = HttpLoggingInterceptor.Level.BODY
        }

        return OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .addInterceptor(logging)
            .addInterceptor { chain ->
                val token = tokenManager.getToken()
                val request = chain.request().newBuilder().apply {
                    if (!token.isNullOrBlank()) {
                        addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer $token")
                    }
                }.build()
                chain.proceed(request)
            }
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideRetrofit(client: OkHttpClient): Retrofit =
        Retrofit.Builder()
            .baseUrl("https://api.example.com/")
            .client(client)
            .addConverterFactory(MoshiConverterFactory.create())
            .build()

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideBankApi(retrofit: Retrofit): BankApi =
        retrofit.create(BankApi::class.java)
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.data.api

import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.logging.HttpLoggingInterceptor
import retrofit2.Retrofit
import retrofit2.converter.moshi.MoshiConverterFactory

object ApiClient {
    fun create(baseUrl: String, tokenProvider: () -> String?): BankingApi {
        val logging = HttpLoggingInterceptor().apply {
            level = HttpLoggingInterceptor.Level.BASIC
        }

        val client = OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .addInterceptor { chain ->
                val original = chain.request()
                val builder = original.newBuilder()

                tokenProvider()?.let { token ->
                    builder.addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer $token")
                }

                chain.proceed(builder.build())
            }
            .addInterceptor(logging)
            .build()

        return Retrofit.Builder()
            .baseUrl(baseUrl)
            .client(client)
            .addConverterFactory(MoshiConverterFactory.create())
            .build()
            .create(BankingApi::class.java)
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankingapp.ui.login

import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel

import javax.inject.Inject

data class LoginUiState(
    val username: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null,
    val isLoggedIn: Boolean = false
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val repository: BankingRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(username = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(isLoading = true, error = null)
            try {
                repository.login(_uiState.value.username, _uiState.value.password)
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(isLoading = false, isLoggedIn = true)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
                    isLoading = false,
                    error = "Login failed"
                )
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
data class HomeUiState(

    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null
)

    private val repository: BankingRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    val uiState: StateFlow<HomeUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(isLoading = true, error = null)
            try {

                val transactions = if (accounts.isNotEmpty()) {
                    repository.getTransactions(accounts.first().id)
                } else emptyList()

                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
                    accounts = accounts,
                    transactions = transactions,
                    isLoading = false
                )
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
                    isLoading = false,
                    error = "Failed to load dashboard"
                )
            }
        }
    }

        }
```
```kotlin
    }
```

```kotlin
        composable(Routes.LOGIN) {
            LoginScreen(
                onLoginSuccess = {
                    navController.navigate(Routes.HOME) {
                        popUpTo(Routes.LOGIN) { inclusive = true }
                    }
                }
            )
        }
        composable(Routes.HOME) {
            HomeScreen(
                onViewTransactions = {
                    navController.navigate(Routes.TRANSACTIONS)
                }
            )
        }
        composable(Routes.TRANSACTIONS) {

        }
```

```kotlin
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.navigation.NavType
import androidx.navigation.compose.NavHost
import androidx.navigation.compose.composable
import androidx.navigation.compose.rememberNavController
import androidx.navigation.navArgument
import com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.dashboard.DashboardScreen
import com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.login.LoginScreen
import com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.transfer.TransferScreen
import com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.transactions.TransactionsScreen

@Composable
fun NavGraph() {
    val navController = rememberNavController()

    NavHost(
        navController = navController,
        startDestination = Routes.LOGIN
    ) {
        composable(Routes.LOGIN) {
            LoginScreen(onLoginSuccess = {
                navController.navigate(Routes.DASHBOARD) {
                    popUpTo(Routes.LOGIN) { inclusive = true }
                }
            })
        }

        composable(Routes.DASHBOARD) {
            DashboardScreen(
                onTransferClick = { navController.navigate(Routes.TRANSFER) },
                onViewTransactions = { accountId ->
                    navController.navigate("transactions/$accountId")
                }
            )
        }

        composable(Routes.TRANSFER) {
            TransferScreen(onBack = { navController.popBackStack() })
        }

        composable(
            route = Routes.TRANSACTIONS,
            arguments = listOf(navArgument("accountId") { type = NavType.StringType })
        ) { backStackEntry ->
            val accountId = backStackEntry.arguments?.getString("accountId") ?: ""
            TransactionsScreen(accountId = accountId, onBack = { navController.popBackStack() })
        }
    }
}
```

### `BankRepositoryImpl.kt`

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.AccountEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.TransactionEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map

class BankRepositoryImpl(
    private val api: ApiService,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) : BankRepository {

    override fun observeAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> =
        accountDao.observeAccounts().map { list ->
            list.map { it.toDomain() }
        }

    override fun observeTransactions(accountId: String): Flow<List<Transaction>> =
        transactionDao.observeTransactions(accountId).map { list ->
            list.map { it.toDomain() }
        }

    override suspend fun refreshAccounts() {
        val remote = api.getAccounts()
        accountDao.upsertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
    }

    override suspend fun refreshTransactions(accountId: String) {
        val remote = api.getTransactions(accountId)
        transactionDao.upsertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
    }
}

private fun AccountEntity.toDomain() = Account(id, name, type, balance, currency)
private fun TransactionEntity.toDomain() = Transaction(id, accountId, title, amount, currency, timestamp, category)

private fun com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.AccountDto.toEntity() =
    AccountEntity(id, name, type, balance, currency)

private fun com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.TransactionDto.toEntity() =
    TransactionEntity(id, accountId, title, amount, currency, timestamp, category)
```

```kotlin
import retrofit2.Retrofit

import javax.inject.Singleton

@Module

object NetworkModule {

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideMoshi(): Moshi = Moshi.Builder()
        .add(KotlinJsonAdapterFactory())
        .build()

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideOkHttpClient(): OkHttpClient {
        val logging = HttpLoggingInterceptor().apply {
            level = HttpLoggingInterceptor.Level.BODY
        }
        return OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .addInterceptor(logging)
            .build()
    }

        Retrofit.Builder()
            .baseUrl("https://api.examplebank.com/")
            .client(okHttpClient)
            .addConverterFactory(MoshiConverterFactory.create(moshi))
            .build()

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideApiService(retrofit: Retrofit): ApiService =
        retrofit.create(ApiService::class.java)
}
```

```kotlin
            SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(5_000),
            emptyList()
        )

    fun refresh(accountId: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            repository.refreshTransactions(accountId)
        }
    }
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.login

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

data class LoginUiState(
    val username: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val loading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null
)

class LoginViewModel : ViewModel() {
    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(username = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login(onSuccess: () -> Unit) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = true, error = null)
            // TODO: call auth repository
            if (_uiState.value.username.isNotBlank() && _uiState.value.password.isNotBlank()) {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = false)
                onSuccess()
            } else {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
                    loading = false,
                    error = "Please enter username and password"
                )
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.AccountEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.TransactionEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankingRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val apiService: ApiService,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) {
    fun observeAccounts() = accountDao.observeAccounts().map { list ->
        list.map { it.toDomain() }
    }

    fun observeTransactions(accountId: String) =
        transactionDao.observeTransactions(accountId).map { list ->
            list.map { it.toDomain() }
        }

    suspend fun refreshAccounts() {
        val remote = apiService.getAccounts()
        accountDao.clearAll()
        accountDao.insertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
    }

    suspend fun refreshTransactions(accountId: String) {
        val remote = apiService.getTransactions(accountId)
        transactionDao.clearAll()
        transactionDao.insertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
    }
}

private fun AccountEntity.toDomain() = com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account(id, name, balance, currency)
private fun TransactionEntity.toDomain() = com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction(id, accountId, title, amount, timestamp)

private fun com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.AccountDto.toEntity() = AccountEntity(id, name, balance, currency)
private fun com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.TransactionDto.toEntity() = TransactionEntity(id, accountId, title, amount, timestamp)
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.di

import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService

import dagger.Module
import dagger.Provides

import okhttp3.MediaType.Companion.toMediaType
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.logging.HttpLoggingInterceptor
import retrofit2.Retrofit
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
object NetworkModule {

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideJson(): Json = Json {
        ignoreUnknownKeys = true
        isLenient = true
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideOkHttpClient(): OkHttpClient {
        val logging = HttpLoggingInterceptor().apply {
            level = HttpLoggingInterceptor.Level.BODY
        }
        return OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .addInterceptor(logging)
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideRetrofit(okHttpClient: OkHttpClient, json: Json): Retrofit {
        return Retrofit.Builder()
            .baseUrl("https://api.example.com/")
            .client(okHttpClient)
            .addConverterFactory("application/json".toMediaType().asConverterFactory(json))
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideApiService(retrofit: Retrofit): ApiService =
        retrofit.create(ApiService::class.java)
}
```

```kotlin
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val apiService: ApiService,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao
) : BankRepository {

    override fun observeAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> {
        return accountDao.observeAccounts().map { entities ->
            entities.map { it.toDomain() }
        }
    }

    override suspend fun refreshAccounts() {
        val remote = apiService.getAccounts()
        accountDao.upsertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
    }

    override suspend fun getTransactions(accountId: String): List<Transaction> {
        return apiService.getTransactions(accountId).map { it.toDomain() }
    }

    private fun AccountEntity.toDomain() = Account(id, name, type, balance, currency)
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.AccountEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.TransactionEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankingRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val apiService: ApiService,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) {
    fun getAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> =
        accountDao.getAccounts().map { list ->
            list.map { it.toDomain() }
        }

    fun getTransactions(accountId: String): Flow<List<Transaction>> =
        transactionDao.getTransactionsByAccount(accountId).map { list ->
            list.map { it.toDomain() }
        }

    suspend fun refreshAccounts() {
        val remote = apiService.getAccounts()
        accountDao.clearAccounts()
        accountDao.insertAccounts(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
    }

    suspend fun refreshTransactions(accountId: String) {
        val remote = apiService.getTransactions(accountId)
        transactionDao.clearTransactions()
        transactionDao.insertTransactions(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
    }
}

private fun AccountEntity.toDomain() = Account(id, name, type, balance, currency)
private fun TransactionEntity.toDomain() = Transaction(id, accountId, title, amount, date, category)

private fun com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.AccountDto.toEntity() =
    AccountEntity(id, name, type, balance, currency)

private fun com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.TransactionDto.toEntity() =
    TransactionEntity(id, accountId, title, amount, date, category)
```

```kotlin
        startDestination = Routes.Login.route
```

```kotlin
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val loginUseCase: LoginUseCase
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _loginState = MutableStateFlow<Resource<Unit>?>(null)
    val loginState: StateFlow<Resource<Unit>?> = _loginState.asStateFlow()

    fun login(username: String, password: String) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _loginState.value = Resource.Loading()
            try {
                loginUseCase(username, password)
                _loginState.value = Resource.Success(Unit)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _loginState.value = Resource.Error(e.message ?: "Login failed")
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.util

import android.content.Context
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.edit
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.stringPreferencesKey
import androidx.datastore.preferences.preferencesDataStore
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map

private val Context.dataStore by preferencesDataStore(name = "session")

class SessionManager(private val context: Context) {

    companion object {
        private val TOKEN_KEY = stringPreferencesKey("auth_token")
    }

    val token: Flow<String?> = context.dataStore.data.map { prefs ->
        prefs[TOKEN_KEY]
    }

    suspend fun saveToken(token: String) {
        context.dataStore.edit { prefs ->
            prefs[TOKEN_KEY] = token
        }
    }

    suspend fun clearToken() {
        context.dataStore.edit { prefs ->
            prefs.remove(TOKEN_KEY)
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

class AuthRepository @Inject constructor(

) {
    suspend fun login(username: String, password: String): Result<Unit> {
        return try {
            val response = api.login(LoginRequest(username, password))

            Result.success(Unit)
        } catch (e: Exception) {

        }
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.di

import android.content.Context
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankapp.util.SessionManager
import dagger.Module
import dagger.Provides
import dagger.hilt.InstallIn
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.logging.HttpLoggingInterceptor
import retrofit2.Retrofit
import retrofit2.converter.moshi.MoshiConverterFactory
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
object NetworkModule {

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideSessionManager(@ApplicationContext context: Context) = SessionManager(context)

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideOkHttpClient(sessionManager: SessionManager): OkHttpClient {
        val logging = HttpLoggingInterceptor().apply {
            level = HttpLoggingInterceptor.Level.BODY
        }

        return OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .addInterceptor(logging)
            .addInterceptor { chain ->
                val token = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking { sessionManager.token.firstOrNull() }
                val request = chain.request().newBuilder().apply {
                    if (!token.isNullOrBlank()) {
                        addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer $token")
                    }
                }.build()
                chain.proceed(request)
            }
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideRetrofit(client: OkHttpClient): Retrofit =
        Retrofit.Builder()
            .baseUrl("https://api.yourbank.com/")
            .client(client)
            .addConverterFactory(MoshiConverterFactory.create())
            .build()

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideApiService(retrofit: Retrofit): ApiService =
        retrofit.create(ApiService::class.java)
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.login

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.domain.usecase.LoginUseCase
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

data class LoginUiState(
    val username: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val loading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val loginUseCase: LoginUseCase
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(username = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login(onSuccess: () -> Unit) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = true, error = null)
            val result = loginUseCase(_uiState.value.username, _uiState.value.password)
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = false)
            result.onSuccess { onSuccess() }
                .onFailure { _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(error = "Login failed") }
        }
    }
}
```

# 18) Important banking-app improvements to add next

For a real banking app, prioritize:

1. **Secure token storage**
   - Use encrypted storage
   - Avoid plain DataStore for sensitive secrets

2. **Certificate pinning**
   - Protect against MITM attacks

3. **Biometric authentication**
   - Add fingerprint/face unlock for app access

4. **Session timeout**
   - Auto logout after inactivity

5. **Root/jailbreak detection**
   - Reduce risk on compromised devices

6. **Fraud and anomaly detection**
   - Backend-driven risk scoring

7. **Audit logging**
   - Track sensitive actions

8. **Accessibility**
   - Screen reader support, contrast, scalable text

9. **Error handling**
   - Network failures, empty states, retry states

10. **Testing**
   - Unit tests, UI tests, integration tests

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toDomain
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankingRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val apiService: ApiService,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) {
    fun observeAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> =
        accountDao.observeAccounts().map { list -> list.map { it.toDomain() } }

    fun observeTransactions(accountId: String): Flow<List<Transaction>> =
        transactionDao.observeTransactions(accountId).map { list -> list.map { it.toDomain() } }

    suspend fun refreshAccounts() {
        val remote = apiService.getAccounts().map { it.toDomain().toEntity() }
        accountDao.upsertAll(remote)
    }

    suspend fun refreshTransactions(accountId: String) {
        val remote = apiService.getTransactions(accountId).map { it.toDomain().toEntity() }
        transactionDao.upsertAll(remote)
    }

    suspend fun transfer(fromAccountId: String, toAccount: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        apiService.transfer(
            mapOf(
                "fromAccountId" to fromAccountId,
                "toAccount" to toAccount,
                "amount" to amount
            )
        )
        return true
    }
}
```

```kotlin
            .build()
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.login

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.domain.usecase.LoginUseCase
import com.example.bankapp.util.Resource
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

data class LoginUiState(
    val email: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val loading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val loginUseCase: LoginUseCase
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState

    fun onEmailChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(email = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login(onSuccess: () -> Unit) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = true, error = null)
            try {
                loginUseCase(_uiState.value.email, _uiState.value.password)
                onSuccess()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(error = e.message ?: "Login failed")
            } finally {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = false)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.local.session

import android.content.Context
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.edit
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.stringPreferencesKey
import androidx.datastore.preferences.preferencesDataStore
import dagger.hilt.android.qualifiers.ApplicationContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import javax.inject.Inject
import javax.inject.Singleton

private val Context.dataStore by preferencesDataStore(name = "session")

@Singleton
class SessionManager @Inject constructor(
    @ApplicationContext private val context: Context
) {
    private val TOKEN_KEY = stringPreferencesKey("token")

    suspend fun saveToken(token: String) {
        context.dataStore.edit { prefs ->
            prefs[TOKEN_KEY] = token
        }
    }

    suspend fun getToken(): String? {
        val prefs = context.dataStore.data.first()
        return prefs[TOKEN_KEY]
    }

    suspend fun clear() {
        context.dataStore.edit { prefs ->
            prefs.remove(TOKEN_KEY)
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.session.SessionManager
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.BankApi
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.LoginRequest
import com.example.bankapp.domain.repository.AuthRepository
import javax.inject.Inject

class AuthRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val api: BankApi,
    private val sessionManager: SessionManager
) : AuthRepository {

    override suspend fun login(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        return try {
            val response = api.login(LoginRequest(username, password))
            sessionManager.saveToken(response.token)
            true
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            false
        }
    }

    override suspend fun logout() {
        sessionManager.clear()
    }

    override suspend fun isLoggedIn(): Boolean {
        return sessionManager.getToken() != null
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.presentation.screens.login

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.domain.usecase.LoginUseCase
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

data class LoginUiState(
    val username: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val loginUseCase: LoginUseCase
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(username = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login(onSuccess: () -> Unit) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(isLoading = true, error = null)
            val success = loginUseCase(_uiState.value.username, _uiState.value.password)
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(isLoading = false)
            if (success) onSuccess() else _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(error = "Login failed")
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.di

import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.BankApi
import com.squareup.moshi.Moshi
import com.squareup.moshi.kotlin.reflect.KotlinJsonAdapterFactory
import dagger.Module
import dagger.Provides
import dagger.hilt.InstallIn
import dagger.hilt.components.SingletonComponent
import okhttp3.OkHttpClient
import okhttp3.logging.HttpLoggingInterceptor
import retrofit2.Retrofit
import retrofit2.converter.moshi.MoshiConverterFactory
import javax.inject.Singleton

@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
object NetworkModule {

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideMoshi(): Moshi = Moshi.Builder()
        .add(KotlinJsonAdapterFactory())
        .build()

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideOkHttpClient(): OkHttpClient {
        val logging = HttpLoggingInterceptor().apply {
            level = HttpLoggingInterceptor.Level.BODY
        }
        return OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .addInterceptor(logging)
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideRetrofit(okHttpClient: OkHttpClient, moshi: Moshi): Retrofit {
        return Retrofit.Builder()
            .baseUrl("https://api.example.com/")
            .client(okHttpClient)
            .addConverterFactory(MoshiConverterFactory.create(moshi))
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideBankApi(retrofit: Retrofit): BankApi =
        retrofit.create(BankApi::class.java)
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.local.datastore

import android.content.Context
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.*
import androidx.datastore.preferences.preferencesDataStore
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map

private val Context.dataStore by preferencesDataStore(name = "user_session")

class UserSessionManager(private val context: Context) {

    private object Keys {
        val ACCESS_TOKEN = stringPreferencesKey("access_token")
        val REFRESH_TOKEN = stringPreferencesKey("refresh_token")
        val USER_ID = stringPreferencesKey("user_id")
    }

    val accessToken: Flow<String?> = context.dataStore.data.map { it[Keys.ACCESS_TOKEN] }
    val userId: Flow<String?> = context.dataStore.data.map { it[Keys.USER_ID] }

    suspend fun saveSession(accessToken: String, refreshToken: String, userId: String) {
        context.dataStore.edit {
            it[Keys.ACCESS_TOKEN] = accessToken
            it[Keys.REFRESH_TOKEN] = refreshToken
            it[Keys.USER_ID] = userId
        }
    }

    suspend fun clearSession() {
        context.dataStore.edit { it.clear() }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.datastore.UserSessionManager
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.LoginRequest
import javax.inject.Inject

class AuthRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val apiService: ApiService,
    private val sessionManager: UserSessionManager
) {
    suspend fun login(username: String, password: String): Result<Unit> {
        return try {
            val response = apiService.login(LoginRequest(username, password))
            if (response.isSuccessful) {
                val body = response.body() ?: return Result.failure(Exception("Empty response"))
                sessionManager.saveSession(body.accessToken, body.refreshToken, body.userId)
                Result.success(Unit)
            } else {
                Result.failure(Exception("Login failed"))
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Result.failure(e)
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.login

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.domain.usecase.LoginUseCase
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

data class LoginUiState(
    val username: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val loading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null,
    val success: Boolean = false
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val loginUseCase: LoginUseCase
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(username = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = true, error = null)
            val result = loginUseCase(_uiState.value.username, _uiState.value.password)
            _uiState.value = if (result.isSuccess) {
                _uiState.value.copy(loading = false, success = true)
            } else {
                _uiState.value.copy(loading = false, error = result.exceptionOrNull()?.message ?: "Login failed")
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
import retrofit2.Retrofit

import javax.inject.Singleton

@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
object NetworkModule {

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideSessionManager(@ApplicationContext context: Context) =
        UserSessionManager(context)

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideOkHttpClient(sessionManager: UserSessionManager): OkHttpClient {
        val logging = HttpLoggingInterceptor().apply {
            level = HttpLoggingInterceptor.Level.BODY
        }

        return OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .addInterceptor(AuthInterceptor(sessionManager))
            .addInterceptor(logging)
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideRetrofit(client: OkHttpClient): Retrofit =
        Retrofit.Builder()
            .baseUrl("https://api.yourbank.com/")
            .client(client)
            .addConverterFactory(MoshiConverterFactory.create())
            .build()

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideApiService(retrofit: Retrofit): ApiService =
        retrofit.create(ApiService::class.java)
}
```

## 18) Important fixes needed in this starter

A few parts above are intentionally minimal and need refinement before production:

### Navigation/login flow
In `NavGraph`, this part is not ideal:

```kotlin
vm.login()
if (state.success) navController.navigate(Route.Home.route)
```

Because `state.success` won’t update immediately. Instead, observe state changes and navigate when success becomes true.

### AuthInterceptor
The interceptor should not use `runBlocking` on a Flow directly. Better:
- store token in memory cache
- or use DataStore with a cached `StateFlow`
- or inject a token provider

### Home/Transactions screens
They currently use `emptyList()` placeholders. You should connect them to ViewModels and repositories.

## 20) Security recommendations for a banking app

For a real banking app, do not ship without:

- **TLS only**
- **Certificate pinning**
- **No sensitive logging**
- **Root/jailbreak detection**
- **Biometric re-authentication**
- **Encrypted local storage**
- **Session timeout**
- **Screenshot prevention** on sensitive screens
- **Play Integrity API**
- **Strong backend auth with refresh token rotation**
- **Fraud/risk controls**
- **Accessibility and audit logging**

### `BankRepositoryImpl.kt`

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toDomain
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.BankApi
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import com.example.bankapp.domain.repository.BankRepository
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map

class BankRepositoryImpl(
    private val api: BankApi,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao
) : BankRepository {

    override fun observeAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> {
        return accountDao.observeAccounts().map { list -> list.map { it.toDomain() } }
    }

    override suspend fun refreshAccounts() {
        val remote = api.getAccounts()
        accountDao.clear()
        accountDao.insertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
    }

    override suspend fun getTransactions(accountId: String): List<Transaction> {
        return api.getTransactions(accountId).map { it.toDomain() }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
@Module
@InstallIn(SingletonComponent::class)
object NetworkModule {

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideJson(): Json = Json {
        ignoreUnknownKeys = true
        isLenient = true
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideOkHttpClient(): OkHttpClient =
        OkHttpClient.Builder()
            .build()

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideRetrofit(json: Json, client: OkHttpClient): Retrofit {
        val contentType = "application/json".toMediaType()
        return Retrofit.Builder()
            .baseUrl("https://api.yourbank.com/")
            .client(client)
            .addConverterFactory(json.asConverterFactory(contentType))
            .build()
    }

    @Provides
    @Singleton
    fun provideBankApi(retrofit: Retrofit): BankApi =
        retrofit.create(BankApi::class.java)
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.navigation

import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.navigation.NavType
import androidx.navigation.compose.NavHost
import androidx.navigation.compose.composable
import androidx.navigation.compose.rememberNavController
import androidx.navigation.navArgument
import com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.accounts.AccountsScreen
import com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.dashboard.DashboardScreen
import com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.login.LoginScreen
import com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.transactions.TransactionsScreen

@Composable
fun NavGraph() {
    val navController = rememberNavController()

    NavHost(
        navController = navController,
        startDestination = Routes.LOGIN
    ) {
        composable(Routes.LOGIN) {
            LoginScreen(onLoginSuccess = {
                navController.navigate(Routes.DASHBOARD) {
                    popUpTo(Routes.LOGIN) { inclusive = true }
                }
            })
        }
        composable(Routes.DASHBOARD) {
            DashboardScreen(
                onAccountsClick = { navController.navigate(Routes.ACCOUNTS) }
            )
        }
        composable(Routes.ACCOUNTS) {
            AccountsScreen(
                onAccountClick = { accountId ->
                    navController.navigate("transactions/$accountId")
                }
            )
        }
        composable(
            route = Routes.TRANSACTIONS,
            arguments = listOf(navArgument("accountId") { type = NavType.StringType })
        ) { backStackEntry ->
            val accountId = backStackEntry.arguments?.getString("accountId").orEmpty()
            TransactionsScreen(accountId = accountId)
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.UserDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.UserEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.LoginRequest
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.User
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import javax.inject.Inject

class AuthRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val api: ApiService,
    private val userDao: UserDao
) {
    suspend fun login(email: String, password: String): Result<User> {
        return try {
            val response = api.login(LoginRequest(email, password))
            val user = User(
                id = response.userId,
                fullName = response.fullName,
                email = response.email,
                token = response.token
            )
            userDao.upsert(
                UserEntity(
                    id = user.id,
                    fullName = user.fullName,
                    email = user.email,
                    token = user.token
                )
            )
            Result.success(user)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Result.failure(e)
        }
    }

    fun observeCurrentUser(): Flow<User?> =
        userDao.observeCurrentUser().map { entity ->
            entity?.let {
                User(it.id, it.fullName, it.email, it.token)
            }
        }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.login

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.data.repository.AuthRepository
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

data class LoginUiState(
    val email: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val authRepository: AuthRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    fun onEmailChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(email = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login(onSuccess: () -> Unit) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(isLoading = true, error = null)
            val result = authRepository.login(_uiState.value.email, _uiState.value.password)
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(isLoading = false)
            result.onSuccess { onSuccess() }
                .onFailure { _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(error = it.message ?: "Login failed") }
        }
    }
}
```

# 12) Repository implementation

## `data/repository/BankRepositoryImpl.kt`

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toDomain
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.BankApi
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import com.example.bankapp.domain.repository.BankRepository
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val api: BankApi,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) : BankRepository {

    override suspend fun login(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        return username.isNotBlank() && password.length >= 6
    }

    override suspend fun getAccounts(): List<Account> {
        return try {
            val remote = api.getAccounts()
            accountDao.insertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
            remote.map {
                Account(it.id, it.name, it.balance, it.currency)
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            accountDao.observeAccounts().first().map { it.toDomain() }
        }
    }

    override suspend fun getTransactions(accountId: String): List<Transaction> {
        return try {
            val remote = api.getTransactions(accountId)
            transactionDao.insertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
            remote.map {
                Transaction(it.id, it.accountId, it.title, it.amount, it.timestamp)
            }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            transactionDao.observeTransactions(accountId).first().map { it.toDomain() }
        }
    }

    override suspend fun transfer(fromAccountId: String, toAccount: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        return amount > 0 && toAccount.isNotBlank() && fromAccountId.isNotBlank()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.login

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.domain.repository.BankRepository
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

data class LoginUiState(
    val username: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val isLoading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val repository: BankRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(username = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login(onSuccess: () -> Unit) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(isLoading = true, error = null)
            val success = repository.login(_uiState.value.username, _uiState.value.password)
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(isLoading = false)
            if (success) onSuccess() else _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(error = "Invalid credentials")
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
        loadAccounts()
    }

    private fun loadAccounts() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(isLoading = true)
            try {
                val accounts = repository.getAccounts()
                _uiState.value = DashboardUiState(accounts = accounts, isLoading = false)
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.value = DashboardUiState(isLoading = false, error = "Failed to load accounts")
            }
        }
    }
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.util

import android.content.Context
import androidx.security.crypto.EncryptedSharedPreferences
import androidx.security.crypto.MasterKey

class SecureStorage(context: Context) {

    private val masterKey = MasterKey.Builder(context)
        .setKeyScheme(MasterKey.KeyScheme.AES256_GCM)
        .build()

    private val prefs = EncryptedSharedPreferences.create(
        context,
        "secure_prefs",
        masterKey,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefKeyEncryptionScheme.AES256_SIV,
        EncryptedSharedPreferences.PrefValueEncryptionScheme.AES256_GCM
    )

    fun saveToken(token: String) {
        prefs.edit().putString("auth_token", token).apply()
    }

    fun getToken(): String? = prefs.getString("auth_token", null)

    fun clear() {
        prefs.edit().clear().apply()
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toDomain
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankingRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val api: ApiService,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) {
    fun observeAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> =
        accountDao.observeAccounts().map { list -> list.map { it.toDomain() } }

    fun observeTransactions(accountId: String): Flow<List<Transaction>> =
        transactionDao.observeTransactions(accountId).map { list -> list.map { it.toDomain() } }

    suspend fun refreshAccounts() {
        val remote = api.getAccounts()
        accountDao.upsertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
    }

    suspend fun refreshTransactions(accountId: String) {
        val remote = api.getTransactions(accountId)
        transactionDao.upsertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.login

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.domain.usecase.LoginUseCase
import com.example.bankapp.util.Resource
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

data class LoginUiState(
    val username: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val loading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null,
    val success: Boolean = false
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val loginUseCase: LoginUseCase
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(username = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = true, error = null)
            val result = loginUseCase(_uiState.value.username, _uiState.value.password)
            _uiState.value = if (result.isSuccess) {
                _uiState.value.copy(loading = false, success = true)
            } else {
                _uiState.value.copy(loading = false, error = result.exceptionOrNull()?.message ?: "Login failed")
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## 13) Repository

### `BankRepository.kt`

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toDomain
import com.example.bankapp.data.mapper.toEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankRepository @Inject constructor(
    private val apiService: ApiService,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) {
    fun observeAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> =
        accountDao.observeAccounts().map { list -> list.map { it.toDomain() } }

    fun observeTransactions(accountId: String): Flow<List<Transaction>> =
        transactionDao.observeTransactions(accountId).map { list -> list.map { it.toDomain() } }

    suspend fun refreshAccounts() {
        val remote = apiService.getAccounts()
        accountDao.insertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
    }

    suspend fun refreshTransactions(accountId: String) {
        val remote = apiService.getTransactions(accountId)
        transactionDao.insertAll(remote.map { it.toEntity() })
    }
}
```

## 11) Repository implementation

### `BankRepositoryImpl.kt`

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.AccountEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.TransactionEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.BankApi
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.LoginRequest
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.TransferRequest
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import com.example.bankapp.domain.repository.BankRepository
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val api: BankApi,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) : BankRepository {

    override suspend fun login(username: String, password: String): Boolean {
        return api.login(LoginRequest(username, password)).success
    }

    override suspend fun getAccounts(): List<Account> {
        val remote = api.getAccounts()
        val entities = remote.map {
            AccountEntity(it.id, it.name, it.type, it.balance, it.currency)
        }
        accountDao.upsertAll(entities)
        return entities.map { it.toDomain() }
    }

    override suspend fun getTransactions(accountId: String): List<Transaction> {
        val remote = api.getTransactions(accountId)
        val entities = remote.map {
            TransactionEntity(it.id, it.accountId, it.title, it.amount, it.timestamp, it.status)
        }
        transactionDao.upsertAll(entities)
        return entities.map { it.toDomain() }
    }

    override suspend fun transfer(fromAccountId: String, toIban: String, amount: Double): Boolean {
        return api.transfer(TransferRequest(fromAccountId, toIban, amount)).success
    }

    private fun AccountEntity.toDomain() = Account(id, name, type, balance, currency)
    private fun TransactionEntity.toDomain() = Transaction(id, accountId, title, amount, timestamp, status)
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.login

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.domain.repository.BankRepository
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

data class LoginUiState(
    val username: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val loading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val repository: BankRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(username = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login(onSuccess: () -> Unit) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = true, error = null)
            try {
                val success = repository.login(
                    _uiState.value.username,
                    _uiState.value.password
                )
                if (success) onSuccess()
                else _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(error = "Invalid credentials")
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(error = "Login failed")
            } finally {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = false)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

- **session timeout**
- **MFA / OTP**
- **backend-driven authorization**

- **audit trails**

### `BankRepositoryImpl.kt`
```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.ApiService
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.LoginRequest
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import com.example.bankapp.domain.repository.BankRepository
import com.example.bankapp.util.Resource
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map

class BankRepositoryImpl(
    private val api: ApiService,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao
) : BankRepository {

    override suspend fun login(email: String, password: String): Resource<String> {
        return try {
            val response = api.login(LoginRequest(email, password))
            Resource.Success(response.token)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Resource.Error(e.message ?: "Login failed")
        }
    }

    override fun observeAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> =
        accountDao.observeAccounts().map { list ->
            list.map { Account(it.id, it.name, it.balance, it.currency) }
        }

    override fun observeTransactions(): Flow<List<Transaction>> =
        transactionDao.observeTransactions().map { list ->
            list.map { Transaction(it.id, it.title, it.amount, it.currency, it.date, it.type) }
        }

    override suspend fun refreshAccounts() {
        val remote = api.getAccounts()
        accountDao.insertAll(remote.map { com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.AccountEntity(it.id, it.name, it.balance, it.currency) })
    }

    override suspend fun refreshTransactions() {
        val remote = api.getTransactions()
        transactionDao.insertAll(remote.map {
            com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.TransactionEntity(it.id, it.title, it.amount, it.currency, it.date, it.type)
        })
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.ui.screens.login

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.example.bankapp.domain.repository.BankRepository
import com.example.bankapp.util.Resource
import dagger.hilt.android.lifecycle.HiltViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import javax.inject.Inject

data class LoginUiState(
    val email: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val loading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null,
    val token: String? = null
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val repository: BankRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState

    fun onEmailChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(email = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = true, error = null)
            when (val result = repository.login(_uiState.value.email, _uiState.value.password)) {
                is Resource.Success -> _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
                    loading = false,
                    token = result.data
                )
                is Resource.Error -> _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(
                    loading = false,
                    error = result.message
                )
                else -> Unit
            }
        }
    }
}
```

## 10) Session manager with DataStore

### `SessionManager.kt`
```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.local.datastore

import android.content.Context
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.edit
import androidx.datastore.preferences.core.stringPreferencesKey
import androidx.datastore.preferences.preferencesDataStore
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.UserSession
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map

private val Context.dataStore by preferencesDataStore(name = "session")

class SessionManager(private val context: Context) {

    private val tokenKey = stringPreferencesKey("token")
    private val userIdKey = stringPreferencesKey("userId")

    val session: Flow<UserSession?> = context.dataStore.data.map { prefs ->
        val token = prefs[tokenKey]
        val userId = prefs[userIdKey]
        if (token != null && userId != null) UserSession(token, userId) else null
    }

    suspend fun saveSession(session: UserSession) {
        context.dataStore.edit { prefs ->
            prefs[tokenKey] = session.token
            prefs[userIdKey] = session.userId
        }
    }

    suspend fun clear() {
        context.dataStore.edit { it.clear() }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.TransactionDao
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.datastore.SessionManager
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.AccountEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.TransactionEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.BankApi
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.UserSession
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map

class BankRepositoryImpl(
    private val api: BankApi,
    private val accountDao: AccountDao,
    private val transactionDao: TransactionDao,
    private val sessionManager: SessionManager
) : BankRepository {

    override suspend fun login(username: String, password: String): UserSession {
        val response = api.login(com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.LoginRequest(username, password))
        val session = UserSession(response.token, response.userId)
        sessionManager.saveSession(session)
        return session
    }

    override fun observeAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> =
        accountDao.observeAccounts().map { list ->
            list.map { it.toDomain() }
        }

    override fun observeTransactions(): Flow<List<Transaction>> =
        transactionDao.observeTransactions().map { list ->
            list.map { it.toDomain() }
        }

    override suspend fun refreshData() {
        val accounts = api.getAccounts().map { it.toEntity() }
        val transactions = api.getTransactions().map { it.toEntity() }
        accountDao.upsertAll(accounts)
        transactionDao.upsertAll(transactions)
    }

    override suspend fun transferFunds(fromAccountId: String, toAccount: String, amount: Double) {
        // Placeholder for initial implementation
        // In production this should call a secure backend endpoint with server-side validation.
    }

    private fun AccountEntity.toDomain() = Account(id, name, balance, currency)
    private fun TransactionEntity.toDomain() = Transaction(id, title, amount, currency, timestamp)

    private fun com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.AccountDto.toEntity() =
        AccountEntity(id, name, balance, currency)

    private fun com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.TransactionDto.toEntity() =
        TransactionEntity(id, title, amount, currency, timestamp)
}
```

```kotlin
    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

                onSuccess()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(error = "Login failed")
            } finally {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = false)
            }
        }
```

```kotlin
    val transactions: List<Transaction> = emptyList(),
    val loading: Boolean = false
)

) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(DashboardUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<DashboardUiState> = _uiState

    init {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            repository.observeAccounts().collect { accounts ->
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(accounts = accounts)
            }
        }
        viewModelScope.launch {
            repository.observeTransactions().collect { tx ->
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(transactions = tx)
            }
        }
        refresh()
    }

    fun refresh() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = true)
            try {
                repository.refreshData()
            } finally {
                _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = false)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.dao.AccountDao

import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import javax.inject.Inject

class BankingRepositoryImpl @Inject constructor(
    private val accountDao: AccountDao
) : BankingRepository {

    override fun getAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> {
        return accountDao.observeAccounts().map { entities ->
            entities.map {
                Account(
                    id = it.id,
                    name = it.name,
                    balance = it.balance,
                    currency = it.currency,
                    accountNumber = it.accountNumber
                )
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kotlin
import javax.inject.Inject

data class AccountsUiState(
    val accounts: List<Account> = emptyList(),
    val isLoading: Boolean = true
)

@HiltViewModel
class AccountsViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val getAccountsUseCase: GetAccountsUseCase
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(AccountsUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<AccountsUiState> = _uiState.asStateFlow()

    init {
        loadAccounts()
    }

    private fun loadAccounts() {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            getAccountsUseCase().collect { accounts ->
                _uiState.value = AccountsUiState(
                    accounts = accounts,
                    isLoading = false
                )
            }
        }
    }
}
```

### `BankRepositoryImpl.kt`
```kotlin
package com.example.bankapp.data.repository

import com.example.bankapp.data.local.BankDatabase
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.AccountEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.local.entity.TransactionEntity
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.BankApi
import com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.LoginRequest
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Account
import com.example.bankapp.domain.model.Transaction
import com.example.bankapp.util.Resource
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.first

class BankRepositoryImpl(
    private val api: BankApi,
    private val db: BankDatabase
) : BankRepository {

    override suspend fun login(username: String, password: String): Resource<String> {
        return try {
            val response = api.login(LoginRequest(username, password))
            Resource.Success(response.token)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Resource.Error(e.message ?: "Login failed")
        }
    }

    override fun observeAccounts(): Flow<List<Account>> =
        db.accountDao().observeAccounts().map { list ->
            list.map { it.toDomain() }
        }

    override fun observeTransactions(): Flow<List<Transaction>> =
        db.transactionDao().observeTransactions().map { list ->
            list.map { it.toDomain() }
        }

    override suspend fun refreshData() {
        val accounts = api.getAccounts().map { it.toEntity() }
        val transactions = api.getTransactions().map { it.toEntity() }
        db.accountDao().upsertAll(accounts)
        db.transactionDao().upsertAll(transactions)
    }

    override suspend fun transfer(
        fromAccountId: String,
        toAccount: String,
        amount: Double
    ): Resource<Unit> {
        return try {
            api.transfer(
                mapOf(
                    "fromAccountId" to fromAccountId,
                    "toAccount" to toAccount,
                    "amount" to amount
                )
            )
            refreshData()
            Resource.Success(Unit)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Resource.Error(e.message ?: "Transfer failed")
        }
    }
}

private fun AccountEntity.toDomain() = Account(id, name, balance, currency)
private fun TransactionEntity.toDomain() = Transaction(id, title, amount, date, type)

private fun com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.AccountDto.toEntity() =
    AccountEntity(id, name, balance, currency)

private fun com.example.bankapp.data.remote.dto.TransactionDto.toEntity() =
    TransactionEntity(id, title, amount, date, type)
```

```kotlin
data class LoginUiState(
    val username: String = "",
    val password: String = "",
    val loading: Boolean = false,
    val error: String? = null
)

@HiltViewModel
class LoginViewModel @Inject constructor(
    private val repository: BankRepository
) : ViewModel() {

    private val _uiState = MutableStateFlow(LoginUiState())
    val uiState: StateFlow<LoginUiState> = _uiState

    fun onUsernameChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(username = value)
    }

    fun onPasswordChange(value: String) {
        _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(password = value)
    }

    fun login(onSuccess: () -> Unit) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = true, error = null)
            when (val result = repository.login(_uiState.value.username, _uiState.value.password)) {
                is Resource.Success -> onSuccess()
                is Resource.Error -> _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(error = result.message)
                else -> Unit
            }
            _uiState.value = _uiState.value.copy(loading = false)
        }
    }
}
```
